about.author: Author
block.manyHelp: Only the fields you change are applied to all selected blocks. In a (mixed) field, enter a signed value such as +1 or -1 to add to or subtract from each block
block.nameHint: Leave blank to use the source filename or default name.
error.noRecord: Recording is not supported in this browser
menu.splitLead: Split into lead, harmony and accompaniment
menu.splitVoicesByPitch: Split harmony into higher and lower (experimental)
menu.splitVoicesByVolume: Split harmony into louder and quieter (experimental)
settings.title: Settings
settings.snapHelp: Snap drags to grid lines, block edges and the cursor. Hold Shift while dragging to ignore snapping.
settings.autoRestore: Autosave your work and restore it next time
settings.rememberFolder: Remember folders for open and save
settings.rememberFolderHelp: Opens the picker in the last used folder (Chrome and Edge only)
settings.recentFilesHelp: Reopen from the File menu (Chrome and Edge only)
settings.confirmCloseHelp: Asks before closing if there are unsaved changes (when autosave is off)
settings.devUpdatesHelp: Notify about new commits even when the version number is the same
settings.autoRestoreHelp: Audio is stored only in this browser and never uploaded
settings.recordHelp: Processing the browser applies while recording. If you will edit the recorded voice, turn all of these off. Choose the input in the recording window
settings.uiScaleHelp: Scales text, inputs, buttons, and everything else together
settings.showMetersHelp: Shows the playback level for the whole mix (toolbar on PC, bottom play bar on mobile) and for each track (track panel)
settings.showDebugHelp: Shown at the bottom left. Toggle with Ctrl+Shift+D
settings.filePickerHelp: Choose Classic if Google Drive or other file managers are unavailable on phones
settings.filePickerAuto: Auto (picker on PC, classic on phones)
settings.outputDeviceHelp: Device used for playback and previews
settings.outputLimitHelp: Keeps loud sounds down to protect your ears and speakers. Does not affect exported audio
settings.extraWindowsHelp: Windows beyond the limit are not autosaved
settings.vocalModelReplaced: {from} is not compatible with the GPU, so {name} is used for extraction
settings.vocalSlowCpu: Without the GPU, this takes about 10 times the song length
settings.vocalGpuHelp: Faster. Falls back to CPU when unavailable or with the light model. Turn this off if the result looks wrong
settings.vocalGpuUnsupported: This model does not support the GPU, so it is processed on the CPU. For faster processing, choose another model
settings.vocalKeepHighBandHelp: Also keeps above about 11 kHz. The voice sounds brighter, but high sounds such as cymbals are more likely to leak in
settings.stemModelHelp: Takes several times the song length (about 6 times without the GPU)
settings.stemChorus: Split vocals into lead and harmony
settings.stemChorusHelp: Also uses the lead vocal model
settings.vocalBeforeAnalysis: Extract vocals before chord separation and one-note cutting
settings.vocalBeforeAnalysisHelp: Removes the accompaniment first, which improves accuracy for songs with accompaniment. Chord separation puts the accompaniment on its own track. One-note cutting uses the vocals only to find the ranges and leaves the track audio unchanged
settings.showLegacyAlgorithmsHelp: List Legacy Solis, Legacy Pisol and Legacy Wevia in the menu and defaults
settings.showVoiceSplitHelp: Adds items to Tools and the block right-click "Vocal extraction" menu that split the selected block into two voices (higher and lower, or louder and quieter) on new tracks. Works best on simple harmony
settings.showDevPluginsHelp: Shows the template plugin for plugin authors in the FX Add list
settings.anticipativeFx: Compute heavy plugins ahead of playback (experimental)
settings.anticipativeFxHelp: Renders tracks that have heavy added plugins on another thread ahead of the playback position. It reduces the load on the audio thread and makes dropouts less likely, but playback takes a moment to start. If you edit such a track during playback, it goes back to normal processing until the next playback.
settings.midiInputHelp: Plays a connected MIDI keyboard through the instrument of a track (the armed track, or the selected track). Recording captures the notes into a MIDI block. Available in Chrome and Edge.
settings.showVstHelp: Lets you pick a VST DLL in Settings > Plugins. The DLL runs in an emulator, so it is heavy; heavy plugins are bypassed automatically during playback. Experimental; some plugins do not work
settings.playbackOffsetMsHelp: Delays the playhead display to match what you hear. Increase it when the playhead looks ahead of the sound, for example on iPad or Bluetooth speakers (the output latency is also subtracted automatically).
settings.anticipativeCacheMbHelp: Keeps pre-computed audio after playback stops, so replaying the same part does not need to compute it again. Set to 0 to keep nothing.
settings.addonFolderHelp: Saves add-ons such as models to a specified folder instead of the browser's storage. Settings and autosaved work are also copied there, so you can restore them even after removing the PWA (Chrome, Edge). Installed add-ons can also be moved to this folder
status.renameHint: Click to rename the project (used for saved and exported files)
track.frozenFx: Frozen (blocks and FX cannot be edited)
track.propertiesHelp: Mixed values are blank. In a mixed field, prefix a number with + or - to adjust each track by that amount. Only edited fields are applied.
export.title: Export
toast.recentMissing: Could not open "{file}" (it may have been moved or deleted)
toast.updateLatest: You are on the latest version
toast.voicesSplit: Split the harmony into two tracks
toast.missingPlugins: Some plugins are not installed ({ids}). Add them in Settings, Plugins. Until then they are bypassed.
marker.title: Marker
marker.name: Name
eq.title: EQ ({name})
eq.help: Drag to draw. Shift adjusts one band finely, Alt smooths with neighbors, double-click resets a band to 0 dB.
eq.applyHelp: Write the EQ into the track audio and reset the EQ to flat
analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.select: Select a block to show its spectrogram and F0
analysis.penHelp: Draw a pitch curve to the traced pitch. Hold Alt to erase
analysis.grabHelp: Drag the pitch line up or down. Inside the time selection moves the selection, otherwise the voiced phrase. Shift snaps to semitones
history.title: History
confirm.newProject: Close the current work and start a new project? Unsaved changes will be lost.
confirm.discard: There are unsaved changes. Discard them and open?
tempo.tapHint: Tap on the beat a few times to set the BPM from the interval
shortcuts.moveBlock: Move a block (edges: length, top corners: fade)
shortcuts.slip: Slip the audio inside a block (edges: stretch)
data.usageUnknown: Usage: not available in this browser
data.workHelp: Autosaved audio and work state. Open work is saved again on the next edit
data.cacheHelp: The app saved for offline use. It is downloaded again next time
data.cacheConfirm: Delete the offline cache? A network connection is needed next time.
data.cacheDone: Cache deleted. It will be downloaded again next time
data.settingsHelp: Settings, panel widths, etc. Resetting reloads the page
data.settingsConfirm: Reset settings and layout, and reload?
data.allHelp: Deletes all of the above and reloads
data.allConfirm: Delete work data, cache, settings and add-ons, and reload? This cannot be undone.
data.persistOn: Granted (the browser will not delete it automatically)
data.persistHelp: Ask the browser not to delete autosaved data when storage is low
data.persistDenied: Denied by the browser (more likely granted for frequently used or installed apps)
data.addonsHelp: Downloaded add-ons ({size}). After deleting, they need to be downloaded again to use
data.folderAddonsConfirm: Delete all add-ons stored in the folder?
data.folderAddonsHelp: Add-ons saved in the folder ({size}). After deleting, they need to be downloaded again to use
data.folderData: Copy of settings and work data
data.folderDataConfirm: Delete the copy of settings and work data in the specified folder?
data.folderDataHelp: Settings and autosaved work copied to the specified folder ({size}). You can restore them from here even after removing the PWA
data.folderRestoreConfirm: Restore the settings and work data from the specified folder and reload. Your current settings and autosaved work will be replaced. Continue?
record.title: Record
window.limit: The number of windows has reached the limit ({n})
window.limitHint: Close another window, or change the limit in Settings
addon.uvrVocFt: Vocal extraction high-quality model (vocals, UVR Voc_FT)
addon.uvrInstHq4: Vocal extraction high-quality model (accompaniment, UVR Inst_HQ_4)
addon.uvrKara2: Vocal extraction lead vocal model (splits lead and harmony, UVR Karaoke 2)
addon.modelLead: Lead vocal model (splits lead and harmony, UVR Karaoke 2)
extract.gpuFallback: Could not process on the GPU ({reason}). Continue on the CPU? This takes longer (about 10 times the song length with high-quality models)
extract.noAdapter: WebGPU is not available (the browser may have blocked WebGPU for this site; fully restarting the browser may fix it)
extract.splitLead: Split into lead, harmony, and accompaniment
midi.loadFailed: Failed to read the MIDI file: {error}
midi.title: Fit pitch to MIDI
midi.empty: The MIDI file has no tracks with notes
sampler.hint: Creates a new track with the selection (or the whole track) placed on each MIDI note at that note's pitch
sampler.title: Place on MIDI
synth.hint: The created audio is added as a new track. You can edit its pitch, length and formant
synth.title: Create audio
vibrato.title: Vibrato
video.title: Export as Video
video.unsupported: This browser does not support video export
pitchTool.hint: The curve appears as a blue line in the pitch lane. Press Apply in the toolbar to render it
snap.title: Snap to scale
snap.nearest: Snap each note to the nearest semitone
kanaCut.intro: Transcribes the singing, adds readings, and finds the range of each mora (a, i, u…)
kanaCut.noGpu: WebGPU is not available in this environment, so transcription cannot run
kanaCut.readingsHelp: Enter readings in hiragana. The range of each sound is found from these readings
kanaCut.title: Cut into single sounds
kanaCut.vocalsFirst: Extract vocals first (for songs with accompaniment)
selection.saveOrDrag: Click to save to folder, drag to a folder to export (WAV)
selection.dragOut: Drag to a folder to export (WAV)
selection.help: Tap tracks or blocks to add or remove them. Tap again to finish
markerTempo.title: Tempo from {name}
algorithm.sola2Hint: For voice. Stays clean on long stretches
algorithm.sola3Hint: Improved Solis. Smooth voice with less breath and roughness
algorithm.psola2Hint: Splices at pitch periods. Less roughness
algorithm.psolaHint: Splices at pitch periods. For voice
algorithm.wsola2Hint: Fast, good for consonants. Less smearing
algorithm.wsolaHint: Overlaps similar waveforms. Fast, good for consonants
algorithm.hpssHint: Stretches drums and tones separately. For songs with drums
algorithm.pv2Hint: For chords and percussion. Sharper attacks
algorithm.pvHint: For chords and percussion. Smooth stretching
algorithm.smsHint: Experimental. Degrades less on round trips and repeated edits. Works on chords and backing too
fx.title: FX ({name})
fx.empty: No effects. Choose one from Add.
fx.missing: This effect ({id}) is not installed, so it is bypassed. Its values are kept.
fx.applyHelp: Writes the FX chain into the track audio and clears the chain
fx.overloadedHelp: Bypassed automatically because it was too heavy and the sound broke up. Turn it off and on to try again.
fx.presetImportError: This is not a preset file for this effect
fx.offlineOnlyHelp: This plugin is applied only when exporting. It is bypassed during playback.
fx.autoLane: Show on the timeline to automate
plugins.intro: Browse the catalog or enter a plugin URL from a trusted source. Installed plugins are saved on this device and work offline (WebAudio Modules are fetched each time they load).
plugins.url: URL of a plugin manifest or a WebAudio Module (.js)
plugins.author: Author
plugins.notice: Plugins run in the same place as this app and are not isolated from it. Add only plugins from authors you trust. A heavy plugin can make the sound break up.
plugins.replace: A plugin with the same id exists. It will be replaced.
plugins.error.api: This API version is not supported
plugins.error.kind: This is not an FX plugin
plugins.error.format: This plugin format cannot be added
plugins.error.reserved: The id of a built-in plugin cannot be used
plugins.error.vst: Could not load the VST (an unsupported DLL, or it uses instructions the emulator does not support)
plugins.error.wam: Could not load the WebAudio Module (it is not a WAM, or shared memory is unavailable)
plugins.noSource: Cannot update because the source is unknown
plugins.vst.notice: Experimental. Heavy plugins are bypassed automatically during playback
plugins.vst.warning: The Windows VST runs in an emulator. Even if it loads, it may not work, for example it may be silent or sound wrong
plugins.vst.load: Estimated load: about {n}% of playback time (per instance)
plugins.vst.loadHeavy: Estimated load: about {n}% of playback time. It cannot keep up with playback, so it is bypassed during playback and applied when exporting
plugins.warning.folderOnly: The plugin was saved to the selected folder but not browser storage. Keep access to the folder enabled to use it.
plugins.catalog.search: Search by name, author, or category
optimize.title: Save Optimized
optimize.help: Saves a lighter copy of the project as a separate file. The current project is not changed
optimize.bakeAll: Commit everything (including volume, fades, and envelopes)
optimize.bakeHelp: Committed blocks are saved with their processed audio as the source. Their processing can no longer be changed
send.title: Sends ({name})
send.help: Sends this track's sound (after the fader) to the input of another track. Send to a track with a reverb to share it among tracks. At the minimum, nothing is sent.
roll.title: Piano roll
roll.help: Click to add a note, drag to move, drag the right edge to resize, double-click or Delete to remove. Shift adds to the selection or drags a box, Ctrl+A selects all. The bottom strip is velocity. Scroll to change the pitch range
instrument.title: Instrument ({name})
instrument.help: The instrument that plays the notes of MIDI blocks. Volume, FX, and pan use the track's.
midiProps.title: MIDI block properties
tool.title: Process with plugin
tool.help: Runs on the current sound of {n} selected waveform blocks and replaces them with the result as a new source (undoable)
project.name: Project name
